Why this exists: three detectors were each written against a single reported
page and merged because the suite stayed green -- and the suite could not go
red, because nothing asked what the new rule did to the other fixtures. A
rule that gains one wall and loses one real page looked identical to a rule
Adding a wall means adding a fixture here, not only a detector. `status` is
the HTTP status the page was served with, which several detectors read.
`url` matters for the redirect and host-titled evidence.
